task: 1. Open a file from the phone
how: Open → pick the file in Android’s picker

task: 2. Type a number into a cell
3. Add up a column with a SUM formula
how: double tap B7 → type "=SUM(" → tap B2 → type ":" → tap B6 → type ")" → Enter

task: 4. See the total of a column without a formula

how: tap row header 1 → Format → Bold → close the panel
tap C3 → Format → a fill colour → close the panel
long press row header 3 → Row above

task: 8. Sort a list by a column
how: tap A3 → Data → Sort A→Z → close the panel

task: 9. Keep the header row in view (freeze)
how: Data → Top row → close the panel

task: 10. Make a bar chart of a table
how: tap A1 → drag the selection handle to C6 → Insert → Bar chart → Add

task: Copy a cell to another cell
how: long press C2 → Copy → long press D2 → Paste
⋮ → Share → pick the app in Android’s share sheet
